title: Adds page limit validation for dispute evidence
summary: Stripe now validates the estimated compiled page count of evidence submitted when you update a Dispute. If the estimated page count of your text fields and file uploads exceeds the network page limit, the API returns a 400 error with the code dispute_evidence_page_limit_exceeded. This validation applies whether or not you set submit to true, so you can catch oversized evidence before final submission. Previously, you could update a Dispute with evidence of any length. Now, if the evidence exceeds the compiled page limit, the requset fails and returns a 400 invalid_request_error with the code dispute_evidence_page_limit_exceeded.

migrationNotes.text: If your integration submits Dispute evidence through the API, requests that exceed the page limit now return a 400 error instead of succeeding. Update your error handling to check for the dispute_evidence_page_limit_exceeded error code. To resolve the error, shorten text fields or reduce the number of pages in uploaded files to stay within the limit.
